# @stackline/sse

> Universal zero-dependency Server-Sent Events toolkit for parsing, encoding,
> fetch reconnection, async iteration, Web Streams and server responses.

- Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/sse/

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/sse
- Security: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-sse/security/policy

Install with `npm install @stackline/sse`.
